basis: Codex action record plus retained passive command artifacts, not an independent audit of external users/processes
passive_operations: docker inspect of three existing reference containers
docker image inspect of the three attached local image IDs
docker network inspect of their existing shared bridge
Read local sources/records, os-release, boot identity, cgroup membership/ancestor limit files and MemTotal; no writes to those resources
offline_operations: Retained JSON/Decimal replay and offline unittest
RRM-only deliverables, authorized PROJECT_STATUS update, explicit local staging/commit
limitation: Before/after continuity supports the lifecycle claim but cannot prove no transient external actions or certify hardware isolation.
